Guidance & outlook: We expect in about a year or 1.5 years' time, we'll be going ahead and we'll be increasing the capacity by almost 50% of our solar plant.
I mean the target in terms of growth for FY '28 itself, it's what 7%, 8% only.
So, we are a lready confident of 10% higher production.
Growth & demand: As far as this quarter is concerned, volumes have been good and price revisions have taken place because costs have gone up.
And that is a result of cost reductions, and bigger production, fixed cost being spread over a bigger volume.

But seeing the way the market is changing and demand for continuous testing and a utomatic testing lines, we will have to need more -- we need to add more lines, which means the project cost is going to increase as well as the capacity is going to increase of this plant.
Margins & costs: And if we remove that, our EBITDA per ton for this quarter comes to INR10,700.
As a result, our EBITDA this quarter is -- for the quarter is INR68 crores for quarter and INR41 crores is the PAT.
Overall EBITDA per ton as Sachit has already explained, it's INR10,760 per ton.
Capex & expansion: Vardhman Special Steels Limited July 23, 2026 Solar plant, we've got a full quarter of savings we've had 2.3 crores units this quarter and roughly 43% of our total power consumption is coming from solar.
And second is on the land acquisition for the 5 lakh -- 5 million plant that we are planning.
Sir, in the opening remarks, you menti oned that the greenfield plant, we are looking to increase the capacity from 5 lakh tons.
Balance sheet & cash: And then we have to obviously touch with banks to raise the debt is also not a problem.
Risks & challenges: These statements are not the guarantee of future performance and involve risks and uncertainties that are difficult to predict.

Guidance & outlook: In the next 2 years, I think we are getting more and more confident that we'll be raising the guidance further.
So this year, our guidance is now up from last year, which is INR8,000 to INR11,000 a ton EBITDA.
But earlier our guidance was to reach up to 20% of exports by the end of FY '27.
Growth & demand: So just to check again, we have sort of INR100 crores to INR150 crores of maintenance capex and then incremental INR400 crores, INR500 crores of growth capex.
Sir, just to take the chronology of events, for this financial year we are modeling in or factoring in a 10% volume growth with a higher EBITDA range by INR1,000.
And this 10% volume will be flattened out for the coming 2 years.
Margins & costs: So total project cost was about INR475 crores, plus our NDT line is also in that same premises.

Europe, as you know, is having a much higher cost of operation because of the gas cost, energy costs being high, wage costs also becoming higher, unavailability of yo ung people to work in the night shifts and in hard-core manufacturing.
So after the plants are established and running towards full capacity utilization, EBITDA on capital employed, we hope to continue to be above 20%.
Capex & expansion: As far as our capex, reheating furnace was commissioned in March.
And sir, just one question on the brownfield expansion, the melting shop, which we are planning to take from 300 to 360 MTPA.
So the total capex that we have planned for the new steel plant is about INR2,000 crores.
Balance sheet & cash: Overall, seeing the confidence in the future, our Board decided to recommend a dividend of INR3.50 a share.
About INR800 crores or so roughly equity and about INR1,200 crores of debt which will be raised.
As you recently said that our capex -- equity will be INR1,200 crores and debt will be INR1,200 crores.
